about.lead: A Bulgarian shop for Japanese and Asian skincare. We import sheet masks, eye patches, sun protection and hand and hair care from Japan, South Korea and Thailand.
about.lead2: We choose products meant to be used every day - with clear ingredients and an honest account of quantity and origin. Skincare is a ritual, not a promise.
about.step1.d: Wash your face and pat it dry with a soft towel.
about.step2.d: Lay the mask over your face and smooth it flat against the skin.
about.step3.d: Relax. The essence sinks in and saturates the skin with moisture.
about.step4.d: Do not rinse - gently pat the remaining essence into the skin.
about.stepsLead: Four steps that take less than 20 minutes.
about.title: Beauty without compromise
about.val1.d: Plant extracts, 100% natural cotton and formulas without the filler - no parabens, alcohol, mineral oils or dyes.
about.val2.d: Peptides, niacinamide, collagen, EGF, ceramides and hyaluronic acid - actives with a clear role to play.
about.val3.d: We work directly with Japanese and Korean lines. Every product arrives in its original packaging with its ingredient list.
